RmlUi 6.3 (https://github.com/mikke89/RmlUi, tag `6.3`), MIT license (LICENSE.txt).

Kept here so the engine can extend it toward the web's styling (see
docs/ui-web-styling.md): only `Include/`, `Source/Core`, `Source/Debugger` and
the CMake files. Backends, samples, tests, Lua, SVG and Lottie were left out.
Changes made for Forge are marked with `// Forge:` comments.
